attchmntText: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd. has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited filed its earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Net revenue for Q2FY27 was Rs 2,716 Mn, a 7% increase year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at Rs 80 Mn, down 43% from Rs 140 Mn in Q2FY26. Basic earnings per share were Rs 3.99. For H1FY27, net revenue reached Rs 5,525 Mn, up 6% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs 258 Mn, a 31% decline from Rs 377 Mn in H1FY26. Basic earnings per share for the half year were Rs 12.87. The company launched Arcana tequila priced at INR 7,500 in Madhya Pradesh. It acquired SDF Industries for Rs 30.85 Cr. The acquisition was approved by the NCLT Kochi Bench on 16th April 2026.

attchmntText: Revised Financial Results for Qtr, ended  30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited submitted revised unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company identified an inadvertent typing error in the Standalone and Consolidated Earnings Per Share figures originally reported on 12 November 2026. The corrected Standalone Basic and Diluted EPS is Rs. 4.14, revised from the reported Rs. 4.17. The corrected Consolidated Basic and Diluted EPS is Rs. 3.99, revised from the reported Rs. 9.91. The company requests the stock exchanges to take the revised results on record and update them on their websites.

attchmntText: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd. has informed the Exchange about Utilisation of Funds
voiceSummary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited filed a statement of deviations or variations in the utilization of funds raised through the issue of convertible warrants on a preferential basis for the second quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company confirms that there is no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from the objects stated in the Offer Document for the Preferential Issue of warrants and its conversion. The statement was duly approved by the Audit Committee. The document was submitted to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 32 of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd. has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Associated Alcohols and Breweries Limited has placed the re-appointment of Mr. Tushar Bhandri, DIN 03583114, as Whole Time Director before its members for shareholder approval via Postal Ballot. The Board of Directors approved this proposal at its meeting held on November 12, 2026, based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee's recommendations. The proposed term is three years, effective from January 5, 2027. Mr. Bhandri specializes in finance with over 20 years of experience, including time as an Investment Banker, and has over 15 years in the liquor industry. He is not debarred from holding the office of Director by any SEBI order or other authority. The final appointment is subject to the outcome of the member approval process.

attchmntText: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd. has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited held a Board Meeting on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also approved the re-appointment of Mr. Tushar Bhandari, DIN 03583114, as Whole-Time Director for a further period of 3 years. This re-appointment and the fixation of his remuneration are subject to the approval of members through Postal Ballot. A draft notice for the Postal Ballot via e-voting has been approved. The financial results are enclosed with the announcement.

attchmntText: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Ltd. has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for the second quarter and half year of the fiscal year 2026-27. The call is set for Friday, 13th November 2026, at 03:30 PM IST. The event will be hosted by Go India Advisors Group. Management representatives include Mr. Anshuman Kedia, Whole Time Director and CEO, Mr. Tushar Bhandari, Whole Time Director, and Mr. Dilip Kumar Inani, Chief Financial Officer. Investors and analysts are requested to pre-register via the provided link to avoid wait time. Dial-in numbers are +91 22 6280 1557 and +91 22 7115 8383. Participants should join 5 to 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time.
